label: Shar tos
note: Mongolian clarified butter, melted gently from tsagaan tos (white butter, made by straining and churning cream)

about.text: Mongolian clarified butter, the yellow oil melted gently from tsagaan tos, the white butter made by straining and churning cream.

how.label: melt gently
how.text: Cream is strained and churned to white oil (tsagaan tos), which is gently melted to separate the yellow oil (shar tos), clarified butter.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Gently melted, which separates the yellow oil (shar tos) from the white oil (tsagaan tos).
